name: Francisco Assis - § 66 - Am 8
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 66. Firmly rejects any initiative from EU institutional partners to explore new avenues for reviewing decision-making, particularly through qualified majority voting; recalls that the national interests and foreign policy priorities of the Member States vary significantly, which can lead to inconsistent application of the Union’s external action tools; underlines, in this regard, that the requirement for unanimity in the Council serves as an essential safeguard to ensure that no Member State is bound by foreign policy decisions that run counter to its fundamental interests; stresses that any attempt to introduce qualified majority voting would constitute a direct challenge to the intergovernmental nature of the Union’s external action and a serious erosion of Member State sovereignty, in accordance with Article 24(1) TEU;
